name: AI Trust Navigator
summary: AI governance assistant that compares one organization's AI governance documents with the NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0): answers compliance questions with citations to both, finds evidence, rates every NIST subcategory Covered/Partial/Missing, and recommends next steps from the NIST Playbook.

scope.grounding: Answers use only ingested documents. Passages are labelled S<n> (standard) and O<n> (organization); only labels actually retrieved become citations. A control mapping is treated as a claim to check, not as evidence.

authentication.required_when: the server has the API_KEY environment variable set

errors.400: Invalid input (empty question, unknown subcategory in /gaps, both or neither of subcategory/control)
errors.404: Unknown subcategory or control (/evidence), or no gap report yet (/gaps/latest)
errors.422: Request body does not match the schema
errors.502: OpenAI or Pinecone call failed, or the model output failed validation twice

capabilities.description: Answer a compliance question. An agent picks tools (search NIST, search organization documents, control mapping, evidence, gap analysis, web search), then answers with citations to both corpora.

output.answer.standard_citations: list of {label, document_id, title, subcategory_id, page, quote, chunk_id}
output.answer.org_citations: list of {label, document_id, title, section, quote, chunk_id}
output.answer.gap_noted: boolean: NIST expects something the organization's documents don't show
output.answer.refused: boolean: question not covered by either corpus
output.answer.needs_live_search: boolean: only live web search could answer (not enabled in v1)

capabilities.description: Answer a compliance question with one retrieval pass over both corpora, no tools. Cheaper and faster than /ask; same answer shape (mode 'simple', empty tool_trace, needs_live_search always false).
capabilities.llm_calls: 1 (2 if the first output fails validation)

capabilities.description: Rate NIST subcategories Covered / Partial / Missing / Not applicable against the organization's documents, with rationale, mapping assessment, cited evidence and Playbook-grounded recommendations. Results are cached per subcategory; unchanged ones cost nothing.

output.findings: list of {subcategory_id, function, category_id, statement, page, mapped_controls, status, rationale, mapping_assessment, evidence[{label, document_id, title, section, date, quote, chunk_id}], recommendations[{action, priority High|Medium|Low, owner_hint, playbook_refs[{label, page, chunk_id}]}], confidence, cached, cost_usd}

capabilities.description: The most recent assessment of every subcategory assessed so far, read from the cache. No model calls.
Organization passages that bear on ONE NIST subcategory or ONE control (at most 2 per document). Retrieval only, no judgement, no LLM call.

subcategory.required: exactly one of subcategory or control

control.required: exactly one of subcategory or control

output.evidence: list of {document_id, title, doc_type, section, date, ai_system, quote, score, chunk_id}

capabilities.description: The organization's controls from its control mapping, each with the subcategories it is mapped to.
The 72 NIST AI RMF 1.0 subcategories (optionally one function), each with its mapped organization controls.

output.subcategories: list of {id, function, category_id, text, page, mapped_controls}

capabilities.description: Add or replace one ad-hoc organization document (plain text). Re-posting the same document_id replaces it. The full corpus is ingested with ingest_docs.py instead.

metadata.values: string, number, boolean or list of strings

capabilities.description: Show which labelled passages each corpus returns for a query, with scores. No LLM call.
Pinecone reachable, index dimension correct, chunk counts per namespace, and whether API-key auth is on. No authentication needed.

not_in_v1: Live web search and monitoring of new AI regulations or guidance (the agent's web_search tool returns 'not enabled in v1' and sets needs_live_search)
Frameworks other than NIST AI RMF 1.0
Legal advice or compliance certification: gap ratings are an assistant's judgement for human review
planned_v2: Enable web_search for regulation and guidance monitoring
